_about: Sonic families: the music palette a brand picks once, like its colour roles. Every cue of the brand comes from ONE family (ideally one album or one composer inside it), so a series always sounds like itself. Moods are the Studio Standard vocabulary used by story.js `music:`. Search strings work in Epidemic Sound, Artlist, Soundstripe or Envato (use them as keywords + the library's mood/genre filters).

problem.what: The set-up, the pain, the joke being built

explain.what: How it works, the idea, teaching

hustle.what: The grind, chaos, posting every day, busy

awkward.what: The mistake, the secret, sneaky, cringe

drop.what: Bad news, the algorithm, the fall

dream.what: Daydream, the beach, the life they want

criteria: Instrumental (no lyrics). Vocal 'oohs' only if the family uses them.
Stems available (melody / instruments / bass / drums), so the melody can step aside under the voice.
Same family instruments as the rest of the brand; prefer the same album or composer for every mood.
A clear downbeat in the first 2 seconds (no long intros) and a version with a clean ending.
Not a viral or trending track (it must sound like this brand, not like everyone's TikTok).
Energy fits a voice on top: no busy lead in the 1-4 kHz range for problem / explain.

quirky-sitcom.name: Quirky sitcom
quirky-sitcom.instruments: pizzicato strings, upright bass, clarinet, bassoon, glockenspiel, whistle, light brushes, the occasional tuba
quirky-sitcom.avoid: EDM drops, trap hats, corporate ukulele, epic orchestra

search.win: happy feel good comedy whistle claps

funk-brass.name: Funk and brass
funk-brass.instruments: horn section, slap bass, clavinet, wah guitar, breakbeat drums, claps

warm-lofi.name: Warm lo-fi
warm-lofi.instruments: rhodes, soft boom-bap drums, upright bass, vinyl texture, muted guitar
warm-lofi.avoid: big drops, brass stabs, cartoon whistles

indie-acoustic.name: Indie acoustic
indie-acoustic.instruments: acoustic guitar, hand claps, glockenspiel, light kit, piano, stomps
indie-acoustic.avoid: corporate ukulele whistling, EDM, trailer drums

orchestral-whimsy.name: Orchestral whimsy
orchestral-whimsy.instruments: chamber strings, woodwinds, celesta, harp, timpani, french horn

retro-synth.name: Retro synth
retro-synth.instruments: analog synths, arpeggios, drum machine, chiptune touches

jazz-lounge.name: Jazz lounge
jazz-lounge.instruments: piano trio, brushed drums, upright bass, vibraphone, muted trumpet

light-hiphop.name: Light hip-hop
light-hiphop.instruments: boom-bap drums, sampled keys, sub bass, scratches (no vocals)
